title: REQ · API client and test fixtures carry no execution code and the frontend type-checks
summary: client.ts execution type and functions, execution tests and fixtures are removed; tests and tsc pass
description: client.ts exports ExecutionInfo, approveExecution, retryExecution, rejectExecution, listExecutions, findExecutionForRound and getCurrentRoundExecution. These are removed. tests/executions.test.ts, tests/adminExecution.test.tsx and tests/adminActions.test.tsx exercise only them and are deleted; executionFixture and failedExecutionFixture are removed from tests/fixtures/api.ts; adminStepper, adminWorld and deriveStage tests are adjusted.
acceptance_criteria: Given client.ts, when imported, then it exports none of the execution functions or ExecutionInfo
Given game/frontend, when npm run typecheck runs, then it exits 0
Given game/frontend, when npm run test runs, then all remaining tests pass
Given game/frontend/src, when searched case-insensitively for approveExecution, retryExecution, rejectExecution, listExecutions, ExecutionPanel, then there are no matches

preserve: Round, world, contribution and player client functions

technical_constraints: Remove ExecutionInfo type only after AdminApp no longer uses it
